plugin.name: resize
plugin._long: A plugin to resize windows by dragging them from any part (not just the edges).

option.name: activate
option._long: When the specified button is held down, you can drag a window to resize it.

option.name: min_width
option._long: If set, views cannot be resized smaller than this width.

option.name: min_height
option._long: If set, views cannot be resized smaller than this height.

option.name: corner_threshold
option._long: Fraction of the view width and height used for corner resize zones.

option.name: activate_preserve_aspect
option._long: When the specified button is held down, you can drag a window to resize it while preserving its original aspect.
